tenderSchedule.title: RFP for Selection of Manpower Agency to Provide Personnel for Revenue & IT Work of GBA
tenderSchedule.description: RFP for Selection of Manpower Agency to Provide Personnel for Revenue & IT Work of GBA

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of Joint Commissioner,IT Section, Annexure 2 Building, GBA Head Office, NR Square, Bengaluru-560002

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have satisfactorily executed in the last 7 years a minimum of three (3) man power services/ IT Professional supply or deployment projects for the Government of Karnataka, any other State Government, Government of India, or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) owned by State or Central Government

The bidder should have an average turnover of Rs 10 Crores in field (s) given in (iii) in the last three accounting Years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 (these three years are mandatory) and 2025-26 (optional

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Turnover from manpower services / IT services/Similar manpower supply should be minimum INR 7.50 Cr in each of the last three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 (these three years are mandatory) and 2025-26 (optional),

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Consortium / Joint Venture bidding shall NOT be permitted
The Agency shall be compliant with applicable EPF, ESI, GST, income-tax and labour laws applicable to its employees and operations
The Agency shall have an operational office in Karnataka for coordination and administration of the engagement
The Agency shall have at least 300 employees on its rolls as on the date specified in the Tender Schedule
The Agency shall not be under insolvency, liquidation, winding-up or similar proceedings as on the bid submission date

The Agency shall not have been blacklisted, debarred or declared ineligible by any Central Government / State Government Department, Government authority, PSU or statutory body as on the bid submission date
The Agency shall not subcontract or outsource the core responsibility of sourcing, engaging and managing the prosonnel required under this RFP

The Bidder should have satisfactorily executed in the last 7 years a minimum of three man power services/ IT Professional supply or deployment projects for the Government of Karnataka, any other State Government, Government of India, or Public Sector
The Bidder should have SEI-CMMI Level 5 Certification or above
Undertaking regarding employment claims and litigation

itemList.itemName: Service Charge (%) on actual monthly remuneration paid for deployed resources to the Agency
